'''Joseph Eichberg''' (born 1935) is an American [[biologist]] specializing in [[signal transduction]] of the [[nervous system]]. He is a professor emeritus in the department of biology and biochemistry at [[University of Houston]]. Eichberg completed his [[Doctor of Philosophy|Ph.D.]] at [[Harvard University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ssl.uh.edu/nsm/biology-biochemistry/people/profiles/joseph-eichberg/index|title=Faculty Profile|website=ssl.uh.edu|language=en|access-date=2019-05-09}}</ref>
